methods.name: Historical secular-trend analysis
methods.description: The report compares many decades of economic ‘what happened / what profited’ data (see Chart 2) to extract long-run structural forces that guide current positioning .

methods.name: Macroeconomic trend assessment
methods.description: Authors identify and investigate today’s dominant macro forces—multipolarity, active fiscal policy, interest-rate normalisation, the innovation super-cycle and China’s balance-sheet recession—framing the investment outlook around them .

methods.name: Public-vs-private balance-sheet analysis
methods.description: Using debt-to-GDP series that contrast household/corporate leverage with public-sector indebtedness, the study gauges financial resilience and policy constraints (Chart 7: divergent leverage trends) .

methods.name: Capital-market theme mapping
methods.description: From the macro work, the authors distil investible themes (Nasdaq+, European value, India & China, Gold & digital assets, CHF store-of-value, etc.) that shape portfolio strategy in the current decade .
